## Summary

- replace the normal 9-tap bloom approximation with renderer-owned multi-resolution HDR bloom
- run bright extraction, a bounded downsample pyramid, filtered upsample, and HDR composite before final tone mapping
- preserve the existing PostProcessSettings, BloomSettings, scene schema, and caller-owned HDR target contract
- rebuild size-dependent bloom resources when the source HDR target changes
- validate bloom pipeline creation and execution when a GPU adapter is available
- document the post-process pass ownership in ADR 0040 and Phase 45

Visual validation is not requested because the repository's current visual workflow captures only the deterministic initial Editor/Launcher shell and does not exercise a bloom-enabled scene.
